basic_details.job_title: Kalaburagi District Court Process-server Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Court of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Kalaburagi (Kalaburagi District Court), Karnataka, has invited applications for 6 posts of Process-server under Advt No. 23/2026. The online application is open from 16 November 2026 to 15 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online through net banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI via the link on the court website; challan, DD, postal order and money order not accepted. Last date to pay the fee: 17 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Minimum 18 years; must not exceed 35+5 years (General), 38+5 years (Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B), 40+5 years (SC/ST/Category-1) (as on the last date fixed for receiving applications)

qualification.education_qualification: Pass in the SSLC examination conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board, Government of Karnataka, or equivalent qualification, as on the last date for applications. Preference to holders of a light motor vehicle driving license.
qualification.details: Qualification: Pass in the SSLC examination conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board, Government of Karnataka, as on the last date for applications, or equivalent qualification; Preference to candidates holding a light motor vehicle driving license Age limit: Minimum 18 years; must not exceed 35+5 years (General), 38+5 years (Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B), 40+5 years (SC/ST/Category-1) (as on the last date fixed for receiving applications) Age relaxation: General Maximum 35+5 years, Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B Maximum 38+5 years, SC/ST/Category-1 Maximum 40+5 years, One-time relaxation 5 years for all categories (GO dated 29.01.2026, notifications up to 31.12.2027), Karnataka Government / local authority / State corporation employees Years of service or 10 years, whichever is less, Ex-servicemen Years of service in the armed forces plus 3 years, Persons with disabilities, widows, bonded labourers 10 years, Census Organisation of Government of India in Karnataka Years of service or 5 years, whichever is less, Released NCC full-time Cadet Instructors Years served as Cadet Instructor, Village group trainers under State rural industrialisation scheme Years served as village group trainer | Other conditions: | Posts are local posts for Kalyana Karnataka region candidates (Local Cadre-371-J) Grade marks of 10th class must be converted to marks by the school headmaster and entered as a percentage out of 100 Only one application may be submitted, stating the reservations claimed | Desirable: | Light motor vehicle driving license (preference)

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay scale Rs. 31775-61300 and other allowances

how_to_apply: Apply only online through the link on https://kalaburagi.dcourts.gov.in/Judges/online-recruitment/ between 16.11.2026 and 15.12.2026 (11.59 PM).
Enter a mobile number (mandatory) and an email ID if available.
Upload a recent colour photo (5cm x 3.6cm, 50kb, jpg) and signature (2.5cm x 7.5cm, 2kb, jpg).
Fill in all details and pay the fee online by net banking, credit card, debit card or UPI by 17.12.2026.
Download the application and keep it with the SBI e-pay receipt until the recruitment ends.
Press upload documents, upload documents, then use Re-print to print the final copy.
important_instructions: Fee once paid will not be refunded If the last fee date is a holiday, the next bank working day is the last date List of candidates eligible for interview will be published on the court website; bring it to the interview Government servants must follow Rule 11 of the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977 No correspondence with the office regarding this recruitment Office phone 08472 221856 (10.00 AM to 6.00 PM)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Kalaburagi District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 December 2026. Applications opened on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Kalaburagi District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies for Process-server.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Kalaburagi District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General: Rs. 200. Category-2A, 2B, 3A and 3B: Rs. 100. SC, ST, Category-1 and candidates with disabilities: Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years; must not exceed 35+5 years (General), 38+5 years (Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B), 40+5 years (SC/ST/Category-1) (as on the last date fixed for receiving applications). Relaxation: General Maximum 35+5 years, Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B Maximum 38+5 years, SC/ST/Category-1 Maximum 40+5 years, One-time relaxation 5 years for all categories (GO dated 29.01.2026, notifications up to 31.12.2027), Karnataka Government / local authority / State corporation employees Years of service or 10 years, whichever is less, Ex-servicemen Years of service in the armed forces plus 3 years, Persons with disabilities, widows, bonded labourers 10 years, Census Organisation of Government of India in Karnataka Years of service or 5 years, whichever is less, Released NCC full-time Cadet Instructors Years served as Cadet Instructor, Village group trainers under State rural industrialisation scheme Years served as village group trainer.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay scale Rs. 31775-61300 and other allowances.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pass in the SSLC examination conducted by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board, Government of Karnataka, or equivalent qualification, as on the last date for applications. Preference to holders of a light motor vehicle driving license.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Posts are local posts for Kalyana Karnataka region candidates (Local Cadre-371-J). Grade marks of 10th class must be converted to marks by the school headmaster and entered as a percentage out of 100. Only one application may be submitted, stating the reservations claimed.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications without fee payment will be rejected. Certificates obtained after the last date or in other formats will not be considered.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting in the ratio 1:25 on the total percentage of marks in the qualifying examination. Interview (10 marks). Candidates called for interview in the ratio 1:25 on total percentage marks in the qualifying examination. Interview carries 10 marks; selection based on interview marks.
